name: r3-drown
description: ⛓⛓⛓ R3-swim D2 — DROWNING, THE GAME'S WAY. L47, `r5-swim-drown`'s boot (208,136) with NO conch, `noDamage`: `right` ×80 into the sea, then still to t 140. `checkDrowning` writes `drownTimer = 10` on the first water tick (t 74) and decrements on every later one; it latches `drowning` on t 84. From t 85 `drown()` runs instead: it spins `v` AND sets `dying`, and `Player.update`'s `if (!dying) super.update()` then skips friction, input and the move — the player stands still for the whole spiral. The twentieth `drown()` (t 104, `drownTimer` 0) is `die()`; observation 104 is the respawn at (216,144). Fixed keys, emitted while the model refused the drowning by name. Authored by scripts/procgen/plan-seedling-r3-death.mjs.
